installCommand: npm install --prefix apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules')) fs.symlinkSync('apps/web/node_modules','node_modules','junction');"
buildCommand: npm run build --prefix apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.next')) fs.symlinkSync('apps/web/.next','.next','junction');"
